updates.body:
The following markets will now enter full-trading mode on @CoinbaseExch, Coinbase Pro and Advanced Trade. Limit, market and stop orders are all now available.

BTC-USD

As part of our scheduled maintenance period, all functionality has been disabled on Coinbase Exchange (including Coinbase Pro). We expect our maintenance period to last up to 8 hours. We will provide an update when functionality has been restored.
